home.headline: Six driveways, one Saturday morning.
home.lede: Find the sales happening near you, then put them in an order that does not send you back across town twice.
home.weekendEmpty: Nothing is listed yet. The next sale posted shows up here.

steps.title: Find the sales
steps.body: Browse by date and status. Cancelled sales stay out of the way unless you ask for them.

steps.title: Build the route
steps.body: Pick the sales you want and give a starting point. The order is worked out from there.

steps.title: Mark them off
steps.body: Tick each stop as visited or skipped while you go, and re-plan the rest if the day changes.

sales.title: Sales
sales.emptyBody: Widen the dates, or clear the filters to see everything listed.

sale.noItems: The seller has not listed individual items.
sale.noCoordinates: This address has not been placed on the map, so routes leave it until last.
sale.signInToAdd: Sign in to add this sale to a route.
sale.onAllRoutes: This sale is already on all of your routes.

saleForm.title: List a sale
saleForm.lede: Buyers see the date, the address and anything you write here.
saleForm.name: Sale name
saleForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Tools, garden pots, a lot of books. Cash only.
saleForm.needSellerTitle: You need a seller profile first.
saleForm.needSellerBody: Sales are listed under a seller name so buyers know who they are visiting.
saleForm.geocodeNote: The address is placed on the map when you list the sale. If it cannot be found, the sale is still listed and routes leave it until last.

routes.title: Your routes
routes.lede: A route is one day of sales, in the order you will drive them.
routes.emptyBody: Pick a few sales and a starting point, and the order gets worked out for you.
routes.deleteConfirm: The route and every stop on it go for good.
routes.signInTitle: Sign in to see your routes.
routes.signInBody: Routes are saved to your account, so you can pick the day back up on your phone.

routeForm.title: New route
routeForm.lede: Name the day, say where you are setting off from, and choose the sales you want to hit.
routeForm.name: Route name
routeForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Cash, tape measure, the big car.
routeForm.startHint: Where you set off from. Leave it empty and stops stay in the order you picked.
routeForm.pickHint: Pick up to 50. The order is worked out from your starting point.
routeForm.noSales: There are no sales to add yet.

route.empty: This route has no stops yet.
route.emptyBody: Add a sale from its page, or pick one below.
route.reoptimizeHint: Re-plans the order from a starting point. Which stops you have visited is kept.
route.addStopHint: Added stops go on the end. Re-order when you want a fresh route.
route.noneToAdd: Every listed sale is already on this route.
route.stopAdded: Stop added to the end of the route.
route.confirmRemove: The sale stays listed. It is only taken off this route.
route.startHint: Where the route sets off from. Changing it does not re-order the stops — use Re-order stops for that.

auth.signInLede: Your routes, your sales, and the sales you have marked off.
auth.registerLede: One account covers both sides: listing a sale and planning a route.

account.title: Account
account.buyerLede: A display name and, if you want, a home address to start your routes from. Your home address is never shared with sellers.
account.buyerNone: You have no buyer profile. It is optional, and you can browse and plan routes without one.
account.sellerLede: Sales are listed under this name. One seller profile per account.
account.sellerNone: You have no seller profile. Set one up to list a sale.

errors.network: The sales service is not responding. Try again in a moment.
errors.forbidden: That is not yours to change.
errors.notFound: That does not exist any more.
errors.invalid: Check the details and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.badCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
errors.startPairNeeded: Give both a latitude and a longitude, or leave both empty.

common.notFoundBody: The page you asked for does not exist.
